 Dubai, UAE – Al Wasl is preparing for a crucial encounter against Iraq’s Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya this Monday evening at Zabeel Stadium, as part of the fourth round of Group B in the AFC Champions League Elite. For “The Emperor,” nothing short of a victory will suffice; the team aims to regain its footing and improve its standing in the race to qualify for the next round.
 Al Wasl enters the match in search of its first victory in the current edition of the continental tournament, having suffered defeats against Al Qadsia and Al Ahli in the opening two rounds. The team remains without any points, sitting at the bottom of the group standings. Additionally, the side has a postponed match against Saudi Arabia’s Al Nassr, which was originally scheduled for the previous round.
 The Emirati team hopes to leverage the advantage of playing at home and before its own fans to secure a positive result. Doing so could bring the team back into contention and provide a morale boost to the players as they continue their tournament campaign—especially since any further setback would make the task of reaching the qualifying positions significantly more difficult.
 Meanwhile, Iraq’s Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya enters the match with high hopes of continuing their positive run, having secured a victory against Azerbaijan’s Neftchi in the previous round. The team earned their first three points and currently sits in eleventh place in the standings. This gives them added motivation to achieve a positive result at Zabeel Stadium.
 In terms of preparations, Al Wasl intensified their training over the past few days under the guidance of their Portuguese coach, Rui Vitória, who is striving to get his players in peak condition for the upcoming match. The team also benefited from their recent participation in the ADNOC Pro League, which demonstrated that they possess players capable of delivering strong performances in major games.
 Al Wasl’s coaching staff is relying on the experience of its players and their ability to handle pressure. Furthermore, they are striving to improve their attacking efficiency and capitalize on scoring opportunities to avoid a repeat of the first two rounds. The team hopes to secure the three points they desperately need.
 Al Wasl fans are also expected to play a significant role in the match, with a large turnout anticipated at Zabeel Stadium. Their presence will be crucial in supporting the players and motivating them to perform at their best. Everyone hopes for a first victory and a return to form in the Asian competition.
